args: BRIDGE=""; [ -f "$HOME/.browser-bridge/up" ] && BRIDGE="--proxy-server http://127.0.0.1:8080 --ignore-https-errors --no-sandbox"; exec npx -y @playwright/mcp@0.0.76 --isolated --browser chromium --executable-path "$(ls -d /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-*/chrome-linux/chrome 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)" $BRIDGE

BRIDGE=""; [ -f "$HOME/.browser-bridge/up" ] && BRIDGE="--proxyServer http://127.0.0.1:8080 --acceptInsecureCerts"; exec npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@1.5.0 --executablePath "$(ls -d /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-*/chrome-linux/chrome 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)" $BRIDGE
